summary: Iteration 20 testing (4 new features: partial_credit, shuffle_options, per-question stats, question bank). Backend: 11/11 pytest assertions pass (parametric partial credit matches spec exactly: 50/0/100/50 and 0 when disabled; shuffle deterministic per session and preserves set; stats endpoint returns correct distribution/success_rate/full_marks/correct; manual grading of short questions properly averaged; bank auto-populated with source=auto, empty-text excluded, PUT /api/exams does NOT duplicate entries thanks to question_id upsert, filters q/type/subject work case-insensitive, DELETE hides item). Frontend: Settings panel exposes both new switches (setting-partial-credit, setting-shuffle-options) and toggle persists aria-checked. Question editor has open-bank-btn opening bank-dialog with items, bank-search-input filtering, bank-add-N copies a question into editor. Results page tabs results-tab-stats / results-tab-copies both work; stats-panel renders stats-total, stats-avg, stat-question-N with distributions marking correct options with ✓.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1189 lines — splitting into routers/ modules (auth, exams, bank, student, admin) would improve maintainability but is not blocking.
GET /api/bank: the `subjects` list is computed with a second DB query — minor perf concern on large banks; could be a $group aggregation.
auto_score partial formula at server.py:275 and front-end autoScore in SessionDetail.jsx:62 are duplicated; keep them in sync (currently equivalent, verified by matching 50/0/100/50 cases).
exam_for_session uses random.Random(seed).shuffle — deterministic as required; good.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own TEST_* prefixed exam via POST /api/exams. Not cleaned up (sessions tied to tests remain). Minor housekeeping, not functional.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter20 features verified end-to-end. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter20_new_features.py is reusable regression suite. For UI, use data-testids: setting-partial-credit, setting-shuffle-options (3. Outils et sécurité tab), open-bank-btn (2. Type et contenu tab after adding at least one question), bank-dialog/bank-search-input/bank-add-N/bank-remove-N, question-to-bank-N, results-tab-stats/results-tab-copies, stats-panel/stats-total/stats-avg/stat-question-N/stat-rate-N/stat-dist-N, grade-auto-N (SessionDetail autoscore badge).
